def factor_volume_return_directional_corr_zvol(df):
    """Rolling correlation between daily return and z-scored volume deviation."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    daily_ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol_mean = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=5).mean()
    vol_std = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=5).std(ddof=1)
    vol_dev = (df_copy["volume"] - vol_mean) / vol_std.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    corr = daily_ret.rolling(30, min_periods=20).corr(vol_dev)
    factor = corr.fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_volume_return_directional_corr_zvol"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_volume_return_directional_corr_zvol"]
description: Preserves the parent's core directional volume coherence mechanism: rolling correlation between signed daily returns and volume surprise. The mutation normalizes volume surprise by its rolling standard deviation instead of relative deviation, making the correlation less sensitive to extreme volume days and aiming to improve Pearson IC while retaining the parent's strong RankICIR and long-short Sharpe. Parent strength target: high RankICIR=0.4240 and long_short_sharpe=5.55.
